info.name: ForwardMeasure Docling Deployment
info.description:
Requests for the current ForwardMeasure Docling Serve deployment and the planned Serve 1.37.0 upgrade, supporting the future forwardmeasure-document-intelligence component.

Import the companion environment, or use collection defaults. The observed deployment uses ClusterIP service docling-docling-serve in namespace docling-serve, with no public ingress. Start:
kubectl --context gke_genai-llm-393115_us-central1_openworkflow-prod -n docling-serve port-forward service/docling-docling-serve 5001:5001 --address 127.0.0.1

Set docling_api_key as a local secret only if API-key authentication is enabled. The collection uses X-Api-Key, not the Geocoding deployment's OIDC flow. Public deployment checks override authentication.

Run Deployment Checks, Standard Conversion's built-in fixture, or the Asynchronous Conversion - Built-in Fixture folder. Async submissions capture docling_task_id; the Runner polls within a configured bound, then fetches the result. When using manual Send, repeat polling until terminal status before fetching. Save results promptly: local task state is ephemeral and fetched results can expire.

HTTP-source requests, file uploads, VLM, hybrid chunking, capability discovery and negative authentication checks are opt-in through clearly named variables. Select actual files in each upload request before enabling it. Repeated multipart to_formats fields represent arrays; Postman supplies the multipart Content-Type boundary automatically.

DocLang smoke checks exercise output presence and retained fixture text through a round trip. They do not perform XSD/Schematron validation or establish complete DCLX asset/geometry fidelity. DCLX export returns an outer ZIP; extract the .dclx member for import.

Verified against the live Serve 1.31.0 OpenAPI contract on October 14, 2026 and reviewed Serve 1.37.0 source. No conversion or administrative clearing request was executed while creating this collection. Source: https://github.com/docling-project/docling-serve/blob/v1.37.0/docling_serve/app.py
Runner scripting: https://learning.postman.com/docs/tests-and-scripts/write-scripts/postman-sandbox-reference/pm-execution/
